summary: Edit functionality testing complete. All 10 tests PASSED. Backend PUT endpoints for /purchases, /salaries, and /other-expenses work correctly. Frontend edit buttons open pre-filled forms with correct dialog titles ('Edit Purchase/Salary/Expense') and 'Update' button text. Auto-recalculation works in edit mode. Dashboard refreshes after edits via dataEvents.emit().

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - cosmetic issue, charts render correctly
Console warnings about missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

critical_code_review_comments: ExpensesPage.js: Edit functionality correctly implemented with editingId state to differentiate edit vs create mode
ExpensesPage.js: openEdit() functions properly pre-fill form with existing record data
ExpensesPage.js: handleSave() correctly uses PUT for editingId and POST for new records
ExpensesPage.js: Duplicate check is correctly skipped in edit mode (only runs on create)
Backend server.py: PUT /salaries/{sid} and PUT /other-expenses/{eid} endpoints properly validate and update records
dataEvents.emit() correctly triggers dashboard refresh after edit operations
seed_data_creation: Tests modified existing demo data - vendor name, salary amount, expense title were updated during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit functionality fully tested and working. All 3 expense tabs (Raw Materials, Salaries, Other Expenses) have working edit buttons with data-testid='edit-purchase-{i}', 'edit-salary-{i}', 'edit-other-expense-{i}'. Edit mode shows 'Edit' in dialog title and 'Update' button. Add mode shows 'Add' in title and 'Save' button. Auto-recalculation works when editing line items.
